summary: Connects to Intel RealSense devices and outputs color, depth, infrared, point-cloud, UV-map, and related camera images.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Capture the selected image stream from the camera.

key_params.name: model
key_params.note: Select RealSense model such as F200, R200, ZR300, SR300, SR305, D415, D435, D455, T265, or L515.

key_params.name: sensor
key_params.note: Select which connected device to use.

key_params.name: image
key_params.note: Choose color, depth, raw depth, aligned images, infrared, point cloud, UV maps, segmentation, or fisheye.

key_params.name: maxdepth
key_params.note: Depth value mapped to pixel value 1.

key_params.name: defaulttradeoff
key_params.note: Use the device default Motion Range Tradeoff.

key_params.name: tradeoff
key_params.note: Tradeoff between motion quality and range.

key_params.name: optionschop
key_params.note: CHOP channels used to set RealSense SDK options by lower-case option name.

key_params.name: skeltracking
key_params.note: Enable Cubemos skeleton tracking where supported.

key_params.name: licensedir
key_params.note: Cubemos license directory for skeleton tracking.

key_params.name: modelfile
key_params.note: Cubemos model file for skeleton tracking.

common_gotchas: Official docs note librealsense SDK v2.50.0 is not expected to be updated for Apple Silicon, so it is unavailable in those builds.
Visualized Depth is display-oriented because the SDK dynamically re-ranges it; do not treat it as actual depth measurement.
Fixed-point depth output clamps beyond 1 while floating-point output can exceed 1.
Several image modes are SDK/platform-specific, including Windows-only RealSense SDK outputs.
RealSense CHOP skeleton tracking is deprecated because Cubemos licenses are no longer available.
Options CHOP channel names should match RealSense option constants with RS2_OPTION_ removed and lowercased.
key_concepts: Connects to Intel RealSense devices and outputs color, depth, infrared, UV, point-cloud, and related camera images.
Depth and raw-depth outputs are re-ranged by Max Depth; fixed-point formats clamp while floating formats can exceed 1.
Depth-to-color and color-to-depth UV outputs are RG 32-bit float textures intended for Remap TOP workflows.
Options CHOP channels set RealSense SDK options by lower-case names with RS2_OPTION_ removed.
